target.title: fix(android): reject IPv6 zone IDs in gateway endpoint URLs
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Gateway endpoint URLs with IPv6 interface zones — e.g. `ws://[fe80::1%25eth0]` — passed cleartext validation but stored a scoped host that OkHttp's URL-string WebSocket path cannot dial reliably, leading to confusing connect failures after UI validation succeeded.

## Why This Change Was Made

**Fail-closed:** reject scoped IPv6 hosts at parse time via `normalizeGatewayConnectionHost()` returning empty when `%` is present, instead of silently stripping the zone (which can target the wrong link-local interface).

OkHttp `Request.Builder.url(String)` cannot represent scoped IPv6 authorities; explicit rejection gives operators a clear invalid-URL outcome rather than a silent endpoint change.

## User Impact

Scoped IPv6 gateway URLs are rejected during endpoint parsing instead of appearing valid and then failing at connect time. Bare IPv6 literals (e.g. `::1`, `fe80::1` without zone) continue to work.

## Evidence

**Unit tests**
- `GatewayConfigResolverTest.parseGatewayEndpointRejectsLinkLocalIpv6ZoneCleartextWsUrls`
- `GatewayConfigResolverTest.parseGatewayEndpointRejectsSecureIpv6ZoneUrls`

**Local proof (Windows, branch `56f96f406b`)**
```powershell
cd apps/android
.\gradlew.bat :app:testPlayDebugUnitTest `
  --tests ai.openclaw.app.ui.GatewayConfigResolverTest.parseGatewayEndpointRejectsLinkLocalIpv6ZoneCleartextWsUrls `
  --tests ai.openclaw.app.ui.GatewayConfigResolverTest.parseGatewayEndpointRejectsSecureIpv6ZoneUrls
```
- Result: `BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 53s`
- JUnit: 2 tests, 0 failures

**ClawSweeper follow-up:** replaced zone-stripping with explicit rejection per review feedback (avoid silent interface change).
